scenario: Gateway cold start loads every existing deployment
steps: Restart the gateway with an empty local state

scenario: Changes made while the gateway was disconnected are applied on reconnect
steps: Stop gateway; undeploy A, deploy C, revoke a key on B; start gateway
expected_result: A 404, C 200, revoked key 401 after reconnect

scenario: platform-api restart: gateway reconnects and later deploys still work
steps: Restart platform-api; deploy a new API
expected_result: Gateway active again; new API invocable

preconditions: 2 platform-api replicas on shared postgres; gateway connected to replica 1
notes: Framework gap: platform-api component has no replicas option
